The Stop hook is failing on the same suite again, and I can't fix it from here. `packages/api-key/src/api-key.test.ts` needs Postgres at `127.0.0.1:5432`, which this environment doesn't have. Docker isn't installed, so I can't start one. The suite crashes on load and runs 0 tests.

My change doesn't touch that suite, and I won't edit or skip it to get the hook to pass. The code change is done. The new organization test passes, and `tsc --noEmit` on `packages/better-auth` was clean.

To clear the hook, start Postgres with `docker compose up -d` on a machine with Docker, or exclude the api-key project from the hook's run.
